inclusion_criterion: A current KO annotation explicitly identifies a chromophore-dependent sensory photoreceptor or light-sensitive regulator.
important_exclusions: Photolyases, generic signaling proteins, and proteins merely regulated by light.

process_represented: Formation and direct modification of carotenoid pigments.
inclusion_criterion: A committed carotenoid-backbone, cyclization, desaturation, hydration, hydroxylation, ketolation, methylation, or glycosylation step.
important_exclusions: General isoprenoid metabolism, unrelated terpenoids, and carotenoid cleavage without pigment-maintenance evidence.

process_represented: Direct catalase, superoxide-dismutase, peroxidase, and peroxiredoxin defense.
inclusion_criterion: Direct catalytic removal of superoxide, hydrogen peroxide, or organic hydroperoxides.
important_exclusions: Generic peroxidases, redox cofactors, chaperones, and indirect redox-support proteins.

process_represented: Direct reversal or excision of UV-associated and bulky DNA lesions.
inclusion_criterion: Direct photoreversal, spore-photoproduct repair, or nucleotide-excision repair of UV-associated or bulky DNA lesions.
important_exclusions: Photoreceptors without repair activity, downstream checkpoints, and generic replication proteins.

process_represented: Other direct DNA-lesion repair, recombination, genome maintenance, and damage bypass.
inclusion_criterion: A specialized direct lesion-repair, recombination, break-repair, fork-restoration, genome-maintenance, or damage-bypass function outside photoreactivation/NER.
important_exclusions: Generic DNA replication, chromosome architecture, nucleotide metabolism, and indirect checkpoint or regulatory proteins.

inclusion_criterion: Direct cellulose-cleaving cellulase, cellobiohydrolase, or cellulose-active LPMO activity; cellobiose dehydrogenase is retained as an explicitly labeled auxiliary.
important_exclusions: Cellulose biosynthesis, binding-only proteins, generic beta-glucosidases, and non-cellulosic glucanases.

process_represented: Backbone or side-chain cleavage of xylan, xyloglucan, mannan, and arabinoxylan.
inclusion_criterion: Direct backbone or side-chain cleavage of a defined plant hemicellulose substrate.
important_exclusions: Generic glycan mannosidases or fucosidases and enzymes without plant-hemicellulose specificity.

process_represented: Backbone or side-chain cleavage and de-esterification of pectin, including pectic type-I galactan.
inclusion_criterion: Direct pectin-backbone, pectin-side-chain, oligogalacturonide, or de-esterification activity.
important_exclusions: Transport proteins, lexical false positives, and generic glycan enzymes without pectin specificity.

process_represented: Hydrolytic degradation of cutin in plant cuticles.
important_exclusions: Generic esterases, lipases, and cutin biosynthesis.

process_represented: Catalytic processing of alpha-glucans (including starch, glycogen, pullulan, and maltodextrin) and fructans. This group is not specific to extracellular litter degradation.
inclusion_criterion: Direct catalytic processing of a defined alpha-glucan or fructan, including starch, glycogen, pullulan, maltodextrin, or inulin.
important_exclusions: Biosynthetic-only enzymes, binding or transport proteins, and central glycolysis; the group is not specific to extracellular litter degradation.

process_represented: Direct catalytic processing of soluble glycosides and small carbohydrates.
inclusion_criterion: Direct cleavage or phosphorolysis of a defined soluble disaccharide or oligosaccharide.
important_exclusions: Transport, central metabolism, glycoprotein processing, and polymer-backbone degradation.

process_represented: Direct, KO-supported lignin-associated oxidative catalysis; broad DyP-family annotation is excluded.
inclusion_criterion: Direct KO-level evidence for lignin-associated oxidative catalysis.
important_exclusions: Generic peroxidases, soluble-aromatic catabolism, ROS defense, and broad DyP-family annotations without lignin specificity.

process_represented: Catabolism of soluble plant/lignin-derived aromatics and pathway-specific intermediates.
inclusion_criterion: Direct catalytic transformation of a defined plant- or lignin-related soluble aromatic compound or a pathway-specific intermediate.
important_exclusions: Biosynthesis, transport or regulation, generic downstream metabolism, endogenous amino-acid routes, and pollutant-specific pathways outside the litter hypothesis.
